strings.Рязанская земля; Ярославский, Кашинский,: The Ryazan land; Yaroslavl, Kashin, Uglich, Tver and Oryol uyezds; the Russian North and the Northern Dvina
strings.деревня Онфилогово при селе Никольское С: the village (derevnya) of Onfilogovo belonging to the village (selo) of Nikolskoye Svechino
strings.Имя восстанавливается из названия деревн: The name is reconstructed from the name of the village of Onfilogovo, first documented in the scribal book of 1539/1540; the person is not named in the entry itself.
strings.Он жил раньше описания деревни, вероятно: He lived before the description of the village, probably in the 15th – early 16th century. His patronymic, social estate, family and exact relationship to the land are unknown.
strings.Форма Амфилохий является вероятным церко: The form Amfilokhy (Amphilochius) is the probable ecclesiastical prototype, but the literal documentary form of the place name reliably preserves only the stem Onfilog-.
strings.Этот профиль отделён от Амфилохия Струнк: This profile is kept separate from Amfilokhy Strunkin, who lived three centuries later: the coincidence of a rare name does not mean identity or kinship.
strings.Родство с орловскими Анфилоговыми не уст: Kinship with Oryol Anfilogovs has not been established; the point on the map shows an observation in the history of the name, not a migration route.
strings.Пояснение, прежде стоявшее в имени карто: Explanatory note formerly included in the card's name: «эпоним деревни Онфилогово» ["eponym of the village of Onfilogovo"].
strings.Деревня действительно хранит память о му: The village really does preserve the memory of a man named Onfilog who lived before 1539/1540. His name is derived from the form Onfilogovo with high confidence; his social estate and biography are not. Two independent personal traces from the right era have now been found. The earliest direct bearer of a close form of the name is Anfilof Selivanov, personally named c. 1495–1497 among six men at a land court of the Yaroslavl tiun. The patronymic parallel closest to the toponym is Tonkoi Onfilogov of Priluk in 1536/1537: his naming preserves the name of a father or senior person, Onfilog, of the preceding generation. Anfilof is stronger as a directly named person of the right time; the Uglich Onfilog as an exact match of the stem Onfilog-. But no document yet connects them with Nikolskoye Svechino and the Tver village. Thus the name and the circle of candidates are established, but the identity of the founder is not yet proven.
strings.Что известно о самом человеке: What is known about the man himself
strings.Его звали в живой речи Онфилог или очень: In everyday speech he was called Onfilog or a very close form; he lived before the first surviving scribal entry; his name was important enough in local memory to become attached to the settlement. His patronymic, family name, age, origin, and legal relationship to the land are unknown. Even the person's sex is inferred not from the ending -ovo but from the male personal stem Onfilog, attested by parallel namings of the period.
strings.Владельца или жителя с таким именем стат: The entry does not name an owner or inhabitant with this name. The name is reconstructed from the oikonym itself: Onfilog-ovo is a settlement that contemporaries associated with a man named Onfilog. Therefore the existence of the eponym is an inference from the form of the name, not a literal quotation about him.
strings.Суффикс -ов- здесь притяжательный. Для л: The suffix -ov- here is possessive. For people of the 16th century the name meant «Онфилогово селение» ["Onfilog's settlement"], «место Онфилога» ["Onfilog's place"], or «деревня, связанная с Онфилогом» ["the village connected with Onfilog"]. It does not mean the Greek "ambush": that is the meaning of the possible church prototype of the name, not the sense of the Russian village name.
strings.Поздняя формула «Анфилогово, Белоглазово: The later formula «Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"] allows a tempting but as yet unproven reconstruction: one man could have been called Onfilog by his calendar or everyday name and Beloglaz by a physical feature. The nickname Beloglaz did exist in the first half of the 16th century. However, the word «тож» ["also called"] just as often links an old and a new name that arose from different people. The exact combination «Онфилог Белоглаз» ["Onfilog Beloglaz"] does not occur in the sources examined, so the card does not merge the two names into one person.
strings.Белоглазово разбирается по той же модели: Beloglazovo is analysed on the same model: Beloglaz- is a personal nickname, -ov- the possessive element, -o the form of a settlement name. The literal historical meaning is «место Белоглаза» ["Beloglaz's place"]. The nickname (literally "white-eye") could refer to very light, grey, or striking eyes, to a peculiarity of gaze, or already be an inherited family name; the source does not explain the motive for the nickname.
strings.Две версии двойного названия: Two versions of the double name
strings.Версия 1: Онфилогово было старым именем,: Version 1: Onfilogovo was the old name, and Beloglazovo appeared later from a new settler, holder, or family. Version 2: Onfilog and Beloglaz are the name and nickname of a single eponym. The question can only be settled by an intermediate record in which the names are dated separately, or in which the person is named by a formula like «Онфилог, прозвище Белоглаз» ["Onfilog, nicknamed Beloglaz"]. Until such a find the first version is the more cautious, while the second remains a valuable line of research.
strings.Название делится на три части: Онфилог-: The name divides into three parts: Onfilog- is the stem of a male personal name; -ov- is an ancient possessive marker meaning "belonging to, connected with"; -o is the neuter ending in the form of a settlement name. The result is not an abstract word but a short formula of memory: «Онфилогово [место, селение, владение]» ["Onfilog's [place, settlement, holding]"]. The personal stem has survived almost intact, so the name is reconstructed with more confidence than the social status of its bearer.
The 1539/1540 book has the form «дер. Онфилогово» ["village of Onfilogovo"], while the General Survey plan has «д. Онфилогова» ["village of Onfilogova"]. These are not two different settlements and not a change of owner. The scribe could use the established neuter name in -ovo, while the survey drawing agreed the possessive adjective with the feminine word «деревня» ["village"]: «деревня Онфилогова» ["Onfilog's village"]. Neighbouring Voronina shows the same cartographic pattern.
strings.Надёжнее всего восстанавливается бытовая: The everyday form Onfilog is the most reliably reconstructed. Anfilog, Anpilog, Ampilog, and Amfilog are real Old Russian variants with wavering initial sounds. The church name Amfilokhy is the most probable, but the forms could also have been confused with the names Amfil, Ampely, and Amply, so an equals sign cannot be placed.
strings.Человек мог быть записан в церковном кал: A person could be recorded in the church calendar as Amfilokhy but be called much more briefly in the family, the village, and in business — Amfil, Amfilokh, Anfilog, or Onfilog. N. A. Petrovsky explicitly gives Amfil and Amfilokh as colloquial forms of Amfilokhy; V. A. Nikonov warns that in real speech similar rare names were confused. Therefore «Онфилог» ["Onfilog"] should be regarded as an independent, documentarily possible everyday form, and «Амфилохий» ["Amfilokhy"] as the most probable reconstruction of the baptismal name, not established by a direct record.
strings.Откуда варианты Ан-, Ам-, Он- и Анп-: Where the variants An-, Am-, On-, and Anp- come from
strings.Редкое греческое имя было непривычно рус: The rare Greek name was unfamiliar to the Russian ear, and scribes recorded living pronunciation without any single passport-style norm. Hence in the documents the initial vowel and the difficult consonant cluster waver: Amf- could be rendered as Anf-, Anp-, or Onf-. These spellings need to be searched in parallel; none of them on its own proves a separate person or a separate family. For the Tver name the starting point remains the literally attested stem Onfilog-.
strings.Амфилохий восходит к греческому имени Am: Amfilokhy goes back to the Greek name Amphilochos. Petrovsky compares it with the ancient Amphilochus and proposes the analysis amphi — "around, on both sides" and lochos — "ambush". This is the history of a distant name, not a literal translation of the toponym. The inhabitants of Tver did not call the place "the village of the surrounding ambush": for them it was Onfilogovo, that is, connected with a specific person whose everyday name already lived its own Russian life.
strings.В основании Онфилогова стоит личное мужс: At the root of Onfilogovo stands a male personal name, not the surname Onfilogov. For the 15th–16th centuries this is fundamental: a surname form would answer the question "whose son or whose family?", whereas a name in -ovo answered the question "whose settlement?". The later surname Onfilogov could have formed independently from the same name, but the village itself does not prove the existence of a family of that name.
strings.Онфилог — не искусственная обратная дога: Onfilog is not an artificial back-formation based on a single Tver name alone. Other 16th-century documents name real people Anpilog and Anfilog: among them are both a pomestye holder and a peasant. This confirms that the rare stem could be a living male name in the relevant era, although none of the namesakes found is our Tver man.
strings.Что дала база из 421 095 служилых людей: What the database of 421,095 service people yielded
strings.Проверка большой именной базы обнаружила: A check of a large name database found Folimon Onfilogov in Oryol in 1689, four matches for the form Anfilog, and 164 for the form Anpilog. The earliest of the surname records shown is Fyodor Anfilogov, Oryol, 1642. A separate check of 17th-century owners gave 159 Starkovs and 118 Yurlovs, but the exact lines «Старков Микита» ["Starkov Mikita"] and «Юрлов Семён/Семен» ["Yurlov Semyon/Semen"] are not in the database. This is no longer dictionary reasoning: the forms Onfilog-, Anfilog-, and Anpilog- were actually used in documents as the basis of personal naming and could produce a surname in -ov. However, the lines found are later than the first description of the Tver village or relate to other places, and do not name its eponym.
strings.Почему орловские Анфилоговы не наши осно: Why Anfilogovs of Oryol are not our founders
strings.Онфилогово существовало не позднее 1539/: Onfilogovo existed no later than 1539/1540, whereas the surname bearers found belong to the 17th century and mainly to Oryol and Kromy. For Yurlov the database gave 118 records, but the combination Yurlov + Tver — none; no Tver matches for the forms Onfilogov, Anfilogov, and Anpilogov were found either. This is a limited negative result within the database, not proof that such people are absent from the archive. The Oryol records confirm the language of the name, but not kinship, migration, or ownership of Onfilogovo.
strings.Что дал новый полнотекстовый поиск РГАДА: What the new RGADA full-text search yielded
strings.24 августа 2026 года проверен поисковый: On 24 August 2026 a search index of 67,263 pages of official RGADA PDF inventories was checked. Within fond 1209, queries for Onfilogovo, Anfilogovo, Beloglazovo, and the exact query Mikita Starkov did not produce the required record. For the single word Starkov only an unrelated Dorogobuzh clerk (podyachy) Ivan Starkov was found; for Yurlov — a contested case of the heirs of S. A. Yurlov from 1741. This does not refute entry No. 272: the handwritten register of d. 16081, where Anfilogovo/Beloglazovo and Mikita Starkov are literally read, is not included in the full-text PDF corpus. Consequently, the digital search is exhausted, and the next evidential step is to obtain the full text of case 16081 itself.
strings.В Тверском уезде было второе Онфилогово: There was a second Onfilogovo in Tver uyezd
strings.Полный справочник А. В. Матисона выявил: A. V. Matison's complete reference work revealed a separate village, «Онфилогово Чагримово тож» ["Onfilogovo, also called Chagrimovo"], in the holdings of Stepan Afanasyevich Likharev in 1588. It came from a different landholding complex and had the stable second name Chagrimovo. Our Onfilogovo is distinguished by the cluster Nikolskoye Svechino — Sadykovo — Ishkovo — Ostrogino — Voronino — Popovo. Therefore a single match of the rare name without neighbours and owner is now insufficient for identification.
strings.Почему второе Онфилогово важно для поиск: Why the second Onfilogovo matters for the search for the man
strings.Два одинаковых названия в одном уезде по: Two identical names in one uyezd show that the name Onfilog could independently give rise to several toponyms. Stepan Likharev is not the owner of our Onfilogovo, and the person who gave the name to Chagrimovo does not become a candidate for founder of Stefanida's village. But this find introduces a mandatory verification rule: every later act must contain at least one stable neighbour or a direct link with Nikolskoye Svechino.
strings.Самый ранний прямой носитель имени: Анфи: The earliest direct bearer of the name: Anfilof Selivanov
strings.В правой грамоте около 1495—1497 годов п: In a judgment charter of c. 1495–1497, after the hearing of the dispute over the Krestsy hayfield on the Kotorosl river, six men present at the court of the Yaroslavl tiun are listed: «А на суде были Гордин соцкой, да Григорей Ярцев, да Мита Галасьев, да Лука Максимов, да Клим Давыдов, да Анфилоф Селиванов» ["And present at the court were Gordin the sotsky, and Grigorei Yartsev, and Mita Galasyev, and Luka Maksimov, and Klim Davydov, and Anfilof Selivanov"]. This is the first direct record found of a living person with the rare form of the name in the generation when Onfilogovo in Tver could already have been taking shape. The source does not call Anfilof an owner, a peasant, or a witness in the narrow legal sense: only his presence at the court is reliably known. He belongs to Yaroslavl, not Tver uyezd, and therefore becomes an early candidate for checking, but not an established founder.
strings.Новый тверской региональный кандидат: от: A new regional candidate from Tver: the father of Peshok Lodygin
strings.В кашинской купчей около 1499—1505 годов: A Kashin deed of purchase of c. 1499–1505 literally names «Пешок Анфилофов сын Лодыгина» ["Peshok, son of Anfilof, Lodygin"]. Peshok acted as a witness (poslukh) and signed; around 1505–1510 he himself wrote another deed of purchase, and in 1515/1516 he was again a witness. His patronymic attests a real Anfilof of the preceding generation, most likely living in the 15th century. The Zhabensky stan of Kashin uyezd belongs to the historical-geographical world of Tver, so this trace is closer to the target milieu than the Ryazan analogues. But Peshok's documents concern Kashin lands and the Trinity Kalyazin Monastery; they contain no Nikolskoye Svechino, Yurlovs, or Onfilogovo. The elder Anfilof Lodygin is a new regional candidate, not a proven founder.
strings.Два Анфилофа в одной сделке 1516 года: Two Anfilofs in one transaction of 1516
strings.Купчая августа 1516 года на четверть дер: A deed of purchase of August 1516 for a quarter of the village of Titovskaya names two different men of the relevant generation at once. Maksim Nesterov sold a share previously bought «у Анфилофья у Иванова сына» ["from Anfilofy, Ivan's son"]; the witness to the transaction was another man — «Анфилоф Мосеев сын» ["Anfilof, son of Mosei"]. The first was a former owner of part of the village, the second took part in certifying the deed. Both belong to the northern Russian complex of the Antoniev-Siysky Monastery, not to Tver, and are therefore not candidates for founder of Onfilogovo. Their value lies in the direct proof that Anfilofy/Anfilof was a living name of people connected with land precisely in the 1510s.
strings.Почему редкость имени больше не решает з: Why the rarity of the name no longer solves the problem
strings.Ранее Анфилоф Селиванов выглядел особенн: Previously Anfilof Selivanov stood out as an almost unique early bearer. The act of 1516 shows two other Anfilofs at the same time. So the name was rare but not unique; a match of form and generation alone does not allow a man from Yaroslavl, Uglich, or the Russian North to be moved to Tver uyezd. In the ranking of candidates, priority now goes not to the rarity of the name but to the presence of a link with Nikolskoye Svechino, the Yurlovs, Khorvach volost, or stable neighbouring villages.
strings.Ближайшая патронимическая параллель: Тон: The closest patronymic parallel: Tonkoi Onfilogov
strings.В копийной книге за 1536/1537 год — всег: In a copy book for 1536/1537 — just three years before the description of our village — after the heading «Село Прилук на реке на Волге» ["The village of Priluk on the river Volga"], among the non-ploughing households, it is literally written: «в. Тонкой Онфилогов» ["in the household, Tonkoi Onfilogov"]. The abbreviation «в.» stands for «во дворе» ["in the household"]. The section concerns peasants of the votchina of the Trinity-Sergius Monastery, so Tonkoi was a monastery peasant with a non-ploughing household, not a pomestye holder. For the first half of the 16th century the form Onfilogov is above all possessive-patronymic: Tonkoi, Onfilog's son or Onfilog's man. The record thus attests not only Tonkoi but also a real Onfilog of the preceding generation.
strings.Почему отец Тонкого попадает в нужное вр: Why Tonkoi's father falls within the right time
strings.Тонкой уже значился самостоятельным двор: Tonkoi was already listed as an independent head of household in 1536/1537. Hence the person from whom his naming Onfilogov is formed belonged at least to the preceding generation and could have been an adult at the turn of the 15th–16th centuries. This is not an exact date of birth: the medieval source reports neither Tonkoi's age nor whether Onfilog was his biological father. But the generational sequence fits the chronology of the Tver name better than all the late 17th-century Anfilogovs found.
strings.Что значит имя Тонкого для поиска: What Tonkoi's name means for the search
strings.Тонкой не является ещё одним вариантом и: Tonkoi is not yet another variant of the name Onfilog and is not named as an inhabitant of Onfilogovo. He is important as the bearer of a dependent naming: his second name preserves the name of another, older person. Therefore the card distinguishes three levels: the Tver eponym Onfilog, existing according to the toponym; the Uglich Onfilog, existing according to Tonkoi's naming; and the hypothesis that this could have been one person. The first two levels are confirmed independently; the third requires a connecting act.
strings.Может ли отец Тонкого быть нашим Онфилог: Could Tonkoi's father be our Onfilog?
strings.По времени — да: отец взрослого монастыр: By time — yes: the father of an adult monastery peasant recorded in 1536/1537 could have lived several decades before the first record of the Tver village. By name the match is exact and rare. Priluk and Nikolskoye Svechino are about 208 km apart, but it has now been established that Priluk peasants and fishermen in the 15th century documentedly passed through the Principality of Tver. This removes the idea of completely separate worlds, but does not name Onfilog himself on Tver land. Therefore Tonkoi's father or senior person is the strongest candidate by form of name, but not a declared founder.
strings.Документированный путь из Прилука через: A documented route from Priluk through Tver
strings.Жалованная грамота тверского великого кн: A charter of grant from Grand Prince Mikhail Borisovich of Tver of 1461–1466 permitted the boats, fishermen, and peasants of the Prisetsky and Priluk holdings of the Trinity-Sergius Monastery to pass duty-free through the Principality of Tver to the Sheksna. Another charter ordered the Kashin toll collectors to let two Trinity boats pass to the village of Priluk and back with grain. Thus people of precisely the community where Tonkoi Onfilogov was later recorded did use the Tver corridor in the generation of his presumed father. So far this is a route of the community, not a personal record of Onfilog.
strings.Новый тверской след: «Анфилов починок»: A new Tver trace: «Анфилов починок» ["Anfilov new clearing"]
strings.В официальной рукописной описи РГАДА най: The literal name «Анфилов починок» ["Anfil's new clearing (pochinok)"] has been found in an official handwritten RGADA inventory. It stands in entry No. 197 on the pomestye of Prince Alexander Gorbaty among the lands of Mikulinsky stan of Tver uyezd. The archival address of the source to which the inventory was compiled is RGADA, f. 1209, op. 1, ch. 2, d. 16081; the entry is visible on the digital image of inventory 94, frame 0123. The possessive form «Анфилов» ["Anfil's"] attests another local eponym, Anfil — the person after whom the new clearing was named. This is the first parallel toponym of the relevant name type found within Tver uyezd, rather than in distant Oryol or Uglich. The earlier reading of the neighbouring «Перевитина» ["Perevitina"] has been withdrawn after magnification: the brief cursive inventory does not allow this place to be named with confidence.
strings.Почему Анфилов починок ещё не наше Онфил: Why Anfilov pochinok is not yet our Onfilogovo
strings.Опись относит статью к Микулинскому стан: The inventory assigns the entry to Mikulin stan, whereas Nikolskoye Svechino and Onfilogovo lay in Khorvach volost in the 16th century; the scholarly map shows them on opposite sides of an administrative boundary. In the entry for Prince Alexander Gorbaty the stable neighbours of our holding — Sadykovo, Ishkovo, Ostrogino, Voronino and Popovo — have not yet been established. Even an identical rare name does not turn two settlements into one: the «починок» ["new clearing"] could independently have taken its name from a different Anfil. This Anfil is therefore a new geographical trace in Tver and a parallel to the local naming pattern, but not a proven founder of Stefanida's village.
strings.Что должно доказать тождество кандидата: What must prove the candidate's identity
strings.Нужна хотя бы одна связующая запись: Тон: At least one connecting record is needed: Tonkoi Onfilogov or his father in Tver uyezd; their land near Nikolskoye Svechino, Voronino or Khorvach volost; the passing of this holding to the Yurlovs; or an old charter in which Onfilogovo is called a new clearing (pochinok) or the land of Onfilog. Without such a bridge the coincidence of a rare name and the right generation remains a strong but circumstantial argument.
strings.Проверена отдельная коллекция Юрловых: A separate Yurlov collection has been checked
strings.Опись коллекции 156 Архива СПбИИ РАН про: The inventory of collection 156 of the Archive of the St Petersburg Institute of History of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SPbII RAN) has been read in full. It relates mainly to the Kurmysh–Nizhny Novgorod branch of the Yurlovs and begins with documents from 1670; Onfilogovo, Svechino and the Tver chain of ownership being sought are absent from it. The only Tver geography in it is connected with the Chirikovs and the Zherebtsovs, not with the Yurlovs. The collection therefore does not reveal the origin of Stefanida and Ivan, but it helps avoid mixing up two different branches of the family.
strings.К 1539/1540 году в Онфилогове уже стояли: By 1539/1540 Onfilogovo already had four households and its name was established. The eponym must be older than this record; a cautious range is the 15th or the very beginning of the 16th century. The number of households does not allow us to decide whether the village arose one generation before the survey or had existed considerably longer.
strings.Наиболее естественная гипотеза — первопо: The most natural hypothesis is a first settler or head of a household around which the village grew: a man cleared a plot, built a homestead, and the new clearing (pochinok) came to be distinguished by his name. A second scenario is a village elder (starosta) or head of several households whose name designated the whole small settlement cluster. A third is a minor service landholder or earlier holder of the land under whom the settlement took shape. All three scenarios are compatible with a name ending in -ovo; one cannot be chosen without an earlier charter.
strings.Название надёжно говорит о связи места с: The name reliably shows a connection between the place and Onfilog, but it does not record a legal act of foundation. He might have been remembered as the first householder, the man who cleared the pochinok, an elder or the owner of the land. The correct designation for now is therefore eponym, that is, the person whose name the place-name preserved; the word «основатель» ["founder"] remains a strong but not yet documented hypothesis.
strings.Стефанида — первая известная нам владели: Stefanida is the first known owner of the complex, but the name Onfilogovo already existed in her time and points to another person. The source does not say that she founded the village, renamed it or descended from Onfilog. Her significance for the search is different: the old charters she did not present could have preserved the chain of earlier holders.
strings.В том же владении стоят Садыково, Ишково: The same holding includes Sadykovo, Ishkovo, Ostrogino, Voronino and Popovo — names of the same possessive pattern. This looks like a layer of settlements that preserved the names or nicknames of different people. However, the order of listing is not a chronology: the fact that Onfilogovo is named first does not make it the oldest village of the complex.
strings.Высокая уверенность: в названии сохранен: High confidence: the name preserves the male name Onfilog, and the person lived before 1539/1540. Medium: the original church form was Amfilokhy (Amphilochius) and the eponym belonged to the 15th to early 16th century. Low, pending a direct act: that he was specifically a peasant first settler rather than an elder or a landholder.
strings.Новый след в отказной книге 1667/1668 го: A new lead in the 1667/1668 transfer book
strings.В рукописной описи тверской отказной кни: In the handwritten inventory of a Tver transfer book (otkaznaya kniga) the heading of entry No. 161 dated 9 November was found: «Ивану Кузмину сыну ...» ["To Ivan, son of Kuzma ..."], followed by a list of lands and a double name. A new check of the enlarged official image corrects it to «Анфилогово, Чагримово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Chagrimovo"]. This is the separate Onfilogovo Chagrimovo known in 1588 as a holding of Stepan Likharev, not our Onfilogovo/Beloglazovo near Nikolskoye Svechino. The archival reference is RGADA, f. 1209, op. 1, part 2, d. 16065, entry No. 161; the full act took up four leaves. It should no longer be ordered for the sake of the Beloglazovo ownership chain.
strings.Кто такой Иван Кузмин сын из новой запис: Who Ivan Kuzmin syn in the new record is
strings.Иван назван в формуле XVII века через от: Ivan is named in the 17th-century formula through his father: «Кузмин сын» ["Kuzma's son"] means "son of Kuzma", not the modern surname Kuzmin. The family designation that follows on the image looks like «Гресов» ["Gresov"], but the reading cannot yet be regarded as established. Even if the four leaves confirmed that this is our Onfilogovo, Ivan would be a later recipient or holder of the land, not the eponym of the 15th to early 16th century. His significance is as a possible bridge to earlier owners whom the transfer act might have listed when explaining the right to the land.
strings.Окончательное чтение: «Анфилогово, Чагри: Final reading: «Анфилогово, Чагримово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Chagrimovo"]
strings.Слово «тож» означает два названия одного: The word «тож» ["also called"] indicates two names for one place. On the enlarged image the second name reads Chagrimovo; the earlier variants «Филогово» ["Filogovo"] and «Дылово» ["Dylovo"] are withdrawn. The match with the published form of 1588 allows the entry to be confidently assigned to another Tver Onfilogovo. Our place is distinguished by its second name Beloglazovo and by its neighbours Nikolskoye Svechino, Sadykovo, Ishkovo, Ostrogino, Voronino and Popovo.
strings.Поздние Анфилоговы Юхотской вотчины: The later Anfilogovs of the Yukhot votchina
strings.Первичные московские исповедные ведомост: Primary Moscow confession registers reveal a separate Uglich cluster: in 1851 the 17-year-old Yefim Anfilogov is described as the son of a peasant of Count Sheremetev from Uglich uyezd; in 1853 the 23-year-old Deomid Anfilogov is described as a peasant from the village of Kostyurina, and the 19-year-old Yevgraf Anfilogov as the son of a peasant from «деревни юхотской» ["a Yukhot village"]. These are genuine bearers of the surname, but they lived more than three hundred years after Tonkoi Onfilogov and cannot be considered his descendants without a chain of revision tales.
strings.Почему Костюрино важно, но не решает зад: Why Kostyurino matters but does not solve the problem
strings.Костюрина входила в обширную Юхотскую во: Kostyurina was part of the extensive Yukhot votchina of the Sheremetevs and lies about 52 km in a straight line from Priluki, where Tonkoi Onfilogov was recorded in 1536/1537. Geographical proximity makes following the censuses of the Yukhot votchina a reasonable direction of search. But Priluki was a monastic votchina of the Trinity-Sergius Monastery, that is, the two settlements belonged to different ownership complexes; a direct family transfer has not yet been found.
strings.Исправление уточнено: Дмитрия нельзя про: Correction refined: Dmitry cannot simply be excluded
strings.В метрической книге за 1859 год он запис: In the 1859 parish register he is recorded as «Димитріем Анфилогѣевым» ["Dimitry Anfilogeyev"], and again as «Анфилогиевъ» ["Anfilogiyev"], not literally as Anfilogov. But Yevgraf's new chain shows one person shifting from «Анфилогов» ["Anfilogov"] to «Анфилогиев» ["Anfilogiyev"] and then to the full «Амфилохиев Стрункин» ["Amfilokhiyev Strunkin"]. Dmitry is therefore retained as a possible member of the same Kostyurino circle, although his kinship has not yet been proven.
strings.Найден буквальный Амфилохий из Костюрина: A literal Amfilokhy from Kostyurino has been found
strings.Ефграф Анфилогов 1853 года в ведомости 1: Efgraf Anfilogov of 1853 is named in the 1858 register as Efgraf Anfilogiyev, aged 25, a peasant of the village of Kostyurina. In the parish registers of 1858 and 1864 his full name is repeated as Yevgraf Amfilokhiyev Strunkin. Alongside him Diomid Amfilokhiyev Strunkin is documented. This means that their actual father bore the name Amfilokhy, popularly Onfilog/Anfilog; this is no longer an etymological guess but a person reconstructed from the repeated patronymics of two sons.
strings.Почему Амфилохий Стрункин не основатель: Why Amfilokhy Strunkin is not the founder of the Tver village
strings.Его сыновья родились приблизительно в 18: His sons were born around 1821 and 1833/1834, so Amfilokhy himself belongs to the late 18th to early 19th century. The Tver Onfilogovo already had four households in 1539/1540. About three centuries lie between the two men: the Kostyurino find proves the living form of the name and the mechanism by which such designations formed, but not identity with the Tver eponym.
strings.Повторная сверка оригинала и независимой: A repeated comparison of the original with an independent copy from 1853 established that Deomid Anfilogov was 23 years old, and that Praskovya Trofimova is the wife of Nikifor Nikolayev from the preceding family. The earlier marital link and the conclusion that Deomid died in 1853–1858 are withdrawn.
strings.На одном листе собрались три линии редко: Three lines of the rare name came together on one leaf
strings.Деомиду Анфилогову в 1853 году 23 года (: Deomid Anfilogov was 23 in 1853 (born around 1829–1830), Diomid Amfilokhiyevich Strunkin was 37 in 1858 (around 1821). This discrepancy does not allow the two men to be merged; the earlier reconstruction of two generations based on an erroneous age of 62 is also withdrawn.
strings.Александра Амфиногиева — возможная дочь: Alexandra Amfinogiyeva — a possible daughter of a man of the same name
strings.В опубликованной выписи из метрической к: In a published extract from the Kostyurino parish register for 1850 the godmother is named as «крестьянская девка Александра Амфиногиева» ["the peasant maiden Alexandra Amfinogiyeva"]. Such a form usually means Alexandra, daughter of Amfinogy/Amfilokhy. The original leaf has not yet been viewed, so linking her to the Strunkins as a sister is premature; the record is kept as a strong direction for verification.
strings.Точный лист следующей ревизии: The exact leaf of the next revision
strings.Оцифрованная ревизская сказка 1782 года: The digitised revision tale of 1782 is held in GAYaO (State Archive of Yaroslavl Oblast): f. 100, op. 7, d. 250; Kostyurino begins on l. 476. The file is available on the official portal only after logging in via ESIA (the state services identity system) and arranging remote access. This leaf may name the older generation of the Strunkins and narrow down Amfilokhy's birth, but until it is viewed, the names of the inhabitants are not added as facts.
strings.Готовая родословная Стрункиных уже сущес: A ready-made Strunkin genealogy already existed
strings.В указателе библиотеки Ярославского исто: The library index of the Yaroslavl Historical and Genealogical Society describes a competition paper by I. Klyukin, "The Fate of a Seasonal Migrant Worker" (Sudba otkhodnika), from 2009. Its main subject is the Korytov peasants of the village of Borok, but among the related lines it literally lists «Стрункин (крестьяне, с. Костюрино)» ["Strunkin (peasants, village of Kostyurino)"]; photographs and photocopies of documents were attached to the paper. The full text has not been found on the open internet, so names from it are not reconstructed. It is, however, an important address: someone has already collected precisely the Kostyurino branch and may have copied family documents that are unavailable in digital archives.
strings.Где искать конкурсную работу: Where to look for the competition paper
strings.Описание опубликовано в теме «Работы кон: The description is published in the thread "Works of the Otechestvo competition" on the YarIRO forum, post No. 4. The society's library page states directly that anyone may ask to see the material. No request has yet been sent to the society: this is an external approach that requires a separate decision by the user. Until a copy is obtained, the paper is treated as a strong research lead, not as a source of established kinship.
strings.Что даёт дело «Деревня Костюрино. 1750–1: What the file "The Village of Kostyurino. 1750–1936" offers
strings.Угличский архив хранит ф. Р-850, оп. 1,: The Uglich archive holds f. R-850, op. 1, d. 4361 titled "The Village of Kostyurino". Fond R-850 consists of land-survey plans of Uglich uyezd; the broad range 1750–1936 therefore relates to the cartographic fond, not to a continuous list of the village's inhabitants. The undigitised plan may clarify Kostyurino's boundaries, roads and neighbours, but the catalogue does not name Amfilokhy or the Strunkins on it.
strings.Два ранних дела о жителях и земле Костюр: Two early files about the inhabitants and land of Kostyurino
strings.В деле Угличского архива ф. 59, оп. 1, д: In the Uglich archive file f. 59, op. 1, d. 220 for 1786, Andrei Vasilyev is named explicitly — a serf of Count Sheremetev from the village of Kostyurino in Yukhot volost. Another file, GAYaO, f. 150, op. 1, vol. 1, d. 667, concerns the ploughing over of the boundary between Kostyurino and Zhukovo in 1803. Amfilokhy himself is not mentioned in the titles, but the full texts may name fellow villagers, elders and witnesses of precisely his generation.
strings.Официальный каталог РГИА подтверждает дв: The official catalogue of RGIA (Russian State Historical Archive) confirms two key paper files of the Sheremetev fond. RGIA, f. 1088, op. 7, d. 16 contains extracts from the scribal, survey and census books of the Yukhot votchina for 1629–1631, 1676–1679 and 1706; d. 65 is a copy of the census books for the Yukhot votchina, which researchers date to 1754. It is precisely these files that may show when the surname Anfilogov first appears in the votchina and in which village. The fond number 188 found in secondary accounts has been corrected: the official reference is fond 1088.
strings.Самый точный крестьянский двойник имени: The closest peasant double of the name
strings.В рязанской судной грамоте 1530-х годов: A Ryazan judicial charter of the 1530s explicitly names the sovereign's peasant «Анфилог Иванов сын Констянтинова» ["Anfilog, son of Ivan, Konstyantinova"] from the grand-princely villages of Podkletnoye and Starotumovo. This is not a reconstruction from a surname: Anfilog is his personal name, Ivanov syn is his patronymic, and Konstyantinova is a further family designation in the form given by the source. He lived exactly in the era of the first record of Onfilogovo and shows that the full form Anfilog really could belong to a peasant.
strings.Почему рязанский Анфилог особенно показа: Why the Ryazan Anfilog is especially telling
strings.Его вызвали не в случайное дело, а в обы: He was summoned not to a random case but to an inquest (obysk) into the origin of the village of Ruposovo: who established the settlement, how many years it had stood and to whom the land had belonged of old. Anfilog was among the 43 people questioned and, together with the others, confirmed the old monastic ownership. Such a document shows a historically real mechanism: the memory of peasants and old residents could preserve the name of the person who built a homestead or a village and then fix it in the name of the place.
strings.Почему это всё ещё не тверской основател: Why this is still not the Tver founder
strings.Рупосово находилось в Рязанском уезде, а: Ruposovo was in Ryazan uyezd, while the Onfilogovo being sought lay near Nikolskoye Svechino in Tver uyezd. The charter contains no Yurlovs, Khorvach, Svechino, Beloglazovo, or any movement of a person between the two lands. Anfilog Ivanov syn Konstyantinova is therefore now the strongest direct parallel for the version "the eponym was a peasant", but not a person who can be transferred to Tver without a new document.
strings.Сплошная проверка персонального индекса: A comprehensive check of the SPbII RAN personal index
strings.Поиск по вариантам и широким началам име: A search by variants and broad name beginnings in the public personal index of the GIS of SPbII RAN produced only three Anfilofs: two people in a northern deed of purchase of 1516 and Anfilofy Ontrofyev syn in a deed of purchase of 1562. The forms Onfilog, Anfilog, Anpilog, Ampilog and Amfilog are absent from the index as separate persons. This removes the hope of an already tagged Tver person in this database, but does not concern the unpublished scribal and pomestye books of RGADA.
strings.Как читать этот новый след: How to read this new lead
strings.Поздние Анфилоговы не заменяют неизвестн: The later Anfilogovs do not replace the unknown Tver Onfilog. They provide a verifiable ladder backwards: from Yefim, Deomid and Yevgraf to the family-by-family list of 1754, then to the census of 1676–1679 and the books of 1629–1631. Only an unbroken chain of names, ages, fathers and villages can lead back to the 16th century; coincidences of a rare surname and region are not enough for this.
strings.Нужен документ старше писцовой статьи ил: What is needed is a document older than the scribal entry, or one that recounts an old charter: a grant, a deed of purchase, a deed of gift (dannaya), an exchange deed, a donation deed, or a record of the transfer of Nikolskoye Svechino. The search should cover Onfilogovo and the variants Anfilogovo, Anpilogovo, Ampilogovo and Amfilogovo, always together with the stable cluster of neighbours. Entry No. 161 in d. 16065 has been excluded as a record of Onfilogovo Chagrimovo. The nearest references are now precise: entries No. 271–272 in d. 16081, estimated ll. 279–283; and the economic notes to dacha (survey plot) No. 516 in RGADA, f. 1355, op. 1, d. 1694, with the alphabetical list of owners in d. 1695.
strings.Полностью просмотрен рукописный алфавит: The handwritten alphabetical list of owners of Zubtsov uyezd for 1794–1808 has been examined in full: GATO (State Archive of Tver Oblast), f. 312, op. 4, d. 14497; FamilySearch, DGS 005371275, frames 775–819. It contains no separate line for Onfilogova next to Voronina. This does not mean that the village disappeared: the list is tied to revision souls, and a landed village shown on the survey plan may have been empty or had no recorded male population. The PGM (General Land Survey plan) and the revision list therefore do not contradict each other.
strings.На кадре 800 того же алфавита распознано: On frame 800 of the same list a large neighbouring Pervitino estate has been identified: Pervitino, Selivanovo, Raslovo, Sablino, Osipovo, Rodionkovo, Nikolskoye, Yagodino, Belavino, Vasilyevskoye, Golovino, Bukino, Romashkovo, Bykovo and Plyusninskoye. The 1782 revision links Pervitino to the heirs of Pyotr Semyonovich Khlopov, but does not name Onfilogova or Voronina. Geographical proximity does not make the Khlopovs the owners of dacha No. 516; such a link can be entered only after a line in the economic notes or the survey book.
strings.Неизвестны отчество, род, занятие и точн: Onfilog's patronymic, family, occupation and exact dates of life are unknown. On the original leaf, the words «дер. Онфилогово: 4 дв.» ["village of Onfilogovo: 4 households"] are immediately followed by the extent of arable land and hay meadow; there are no names of the heads of households. Kinship with the later Anfilogovs has not been established.
strings.До 1600 года имя Анфилоф/Анфилог, близки: Before 1600 the name Anfilof/Anfilog, the close forms Anfil/Onfil and derived patronymics are documented in at least seven regional settings. The northern series now includes the Anfilovskaya village of 1573 and the sheepskin-maker Anfilofy Novik Ivanov syn of 1575; the Vladimir muster roll (desyatnya) of 1596 shows on the primary scan the exact formula «Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Anfilov son of Vakin"]. This makes the model of several independent family formations more probable than the search for one common incoming founder, but the towns of origin of the seven Oryol lines have not yet been established.
strings.ИМЕНА И МЕХАНИЗМ. Реестр показывает две:
NAMES AND MECHANISM. The register shows two different stages. In the first, Anfilof, Anfilog or the close documentary forms Anfil and Onfil are the personal name of a specific man: Anfilof Selivanov, Anfilofy Ivanovich, Anfilof Moiseyevich, Anfilog Ivanovich Konstantinov, Onfilof Nesterov, Onfil Ivanov, Anfil Vakin of Vladimir and Anpilog Ivanovich Onanyin. In the second, the name becomes a dependent naming of another person: Antipa Anfilogov syn, Peshok Anfilofov syn, Tonkoi Onfilogov and Antip Anfilov syn Vakina. Hence the -ov form existed as a patronymic or family naming long before it can confidently be regarded as a hereditary surname.

THE 16TH-CENTURY INTERVAL. The Kurostrov scrolls give a dense cross-section: in 1549 Onfilof Nesterov pays together with his nephew, in the 1550s he is probably repeated as «Анфилофей Несте…» ["Anfilofey Neste…"], and in 1592 Onfil Ivanov is recorded separately. In 1596 the Vladimir muster roll adds the formula «Антип Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Antip Anfilov son of Vakin"], which on the primary scan clearly separates the patronymic Anfilov and the third naming Vakin. Nearby occur Petrok Anfilov and a long line of Anfal / Anfalov. They are kept for comparison but not mixed into the main series: A. F. Bek's reference book lists Anfalov from Aifal/Anfal separately from Anfilov from Amfilokhy or Anfim.

GEOGRAPHY. The bearers do not form a single linear path. They appear simultaneously in the Ryazan land, Yaroslavl, Kashin, Vladimir, the Russian North, the Northern Dvina and Uglich. This distribution is too wide for the assumption of one common recent ancestor. Ryazan stands out for the repetition of the name in different generations and for its proximity to the documented resettlement of servicemen to the new southern towns; the Kashin–Uglich circle for its proximity to the Tver Onfilogovo; Vladimir for a formula contemporary with Oryol but independent. None of them has yet been connected to Oryol by a personal move.

MEANING FOR THE ORYOL CORE. In Oryol in 1594/95 there already existed at least seven fathers of surname bearers: Mikula, Vasily, Persha, Timofey, Nechay, Pakhom and Terenty. At the same time, in another Oryol nest, a pomeshchik with the personal name Anpilog Onanyin is known. The most economical new model is not to look for one ready-made family that suddenly arrived in Oryol, but to examine several families in which the name Anfilog could independently have turned into a patronymic and then into a stable family naming.
strings.Найти служебные продолжения рязанских но: Find service continuations of the Ryazan bearers of the name between the 1530s and the founding of Oryol.
strings.Вернуться к Лодыгиным только при появлен: Return to the Lodygins only if a patronymic, inherited land or a direct formula of transfer between the Kashin circle and southern service appears.
strings.Искать семерых орловских отцов по полным: Search for the seven Oryol fathers by full formulas and former pomestyes, without assuming a common surname in advance.
strings.Заказать однолистные акты Архива СПбИИ Р: Order the single-sheet acts of the Archive of the St Petersburg Institute of History of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SPbII RAN), f. 5, op. 1, d. 554 and 567: check the boundaries of the Anfilovskaya village and the full formulary of Anfilofy Novik's deed of purchase.
strings.Не объединять региональные случаи без пр: Do not merge regional cases without a direct kinship or migration formula.
strings.человек, давший название: the person who gave the name
strings.Деревня Онфилогово в Юрьевском стане вол: The hamlet of Onfilogovo in Yuryevsky stan of Khorvach volost, Tver uyezd, is recorded in the scribal book of 7048 (1539/1540). Examination of the RGADA original on l. 183 ob.–184 confirmed the form of the name and the four households, but showed that the scribe did not record the names of the inhabitants. From the toponym the everyday name of the eponym — Onfilog — can be confidently reconstructed. Most likely this is a vernacular form of the name Amfilokhy (Amphilochius), although closely related forms could be mixed with the names Amfil, Ampely and Amply. A new land inventory after 1634/1635 for the first time continues the history of the place itself: in Yuryevsky stan, article No. 272 names «поместье Микиты Старкова, пустошь Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["the pomestye of Mikita Starkov, the waste land Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"]. The neighbouring articles distribute Stefanida's former holding between Veriga Bulbin and Semyon Yurlov. This confirms the identity of the settlement and shows its desertion, but does not make Mikita Starkov the founder: he appears about a century after the eponym.
strings.ЛЮДИ, НАЗВАННЫЕ В ЗАПИСИ. Формула «за Ст:
PEOPLE NAMED IN THE RECORD. The formula «за Стефанидою за Ивановою женою Юрлова» ["held by Stefanida, wife of Ivan Yurlov"] names the landholder Stefanida and her husband Ivan Yurlov. «Иванова жена» ["Ivan's wife"] means "the wife of Ivan", not Stefanida's patronymic; her own patronymic and maiden name are unknown. The word «вдова» ["widow"] is absent, so the literal line does not report a death directly. However, A. V. Matison, having examined the complex of Tver scribal materials, classifies him as «Юрлов Иван (до 1539)» ["Yurlov Ivan (before 1539)"] — a former owner nowhere found alive — and links Nikolskoye Svechino held by Stefanida to his holding. Most probably Ivan died before 1539, and his wife continued to hold the complex. The form «Юрлова» ["Yurlova"] is the feminine form of the male byname or family name Yurlov. Among the known 16th-century Yurlovs, the best candidate for Stefanida's husband is now Ivan Timofeyevich Yurlov-Pleshcheyev Bolshoi. After his flight to Lithuania his first wife, not named, remained in the Muscovite state and in 1511–1512 figured three times in negotiations for permission to leave and join her husband; Vasily III did not let her go. In Lithuania Ivan married a second time, Hanna Khrebtovich; he was last found alive on 30 January 1529, and in 1532 Hanna was already disposing of his property. This biography matches Stefanida's situation exactly in country and time, but the name of the first wife and her holdings are not revealed. Therefore Ivan Bolshoi is the leading candidate, not a proven husband.

A NEW YURLOV–UGLICH BRIDGE. The testamentary charter of Prince Dmitry Zhilka, drawn up before 14 February 1521, says: «а у Ивана у Юрлова у меншово купил есми село Инково з деревнями» ["and from Ivan Yurlov Menshoi I bought the village of Inkovo with its hamlets"]. The 1950 academic edition and its geographical index twice print «Инково» ["Inkovo"] and assign it to Uglich uyezd; the electronic transcriptions on Vostlit and DrevLit give the variant «Ипково» ["Ipkovo"]. In the same Uglich uyezd in 1536/1537 lived Tonkoi Onfilogov. Thus the family name Yurlov and the rare patronymic naming Onfilogov for the first time converge in one uyezd and one generation. But Inkovo and Priluki have not yet been brought into a single landholding complex, the wife of Ivan Menshoi has not been identified, and the transfer of Nikolskoye Svechino to Stefanida has not been traced. This is a strong line of research, not a proven identity.

WHO CREATED THE DOCUMENT. The survey was carried out by the sovereign's scribes Ivan Petrovich Zabolotsky and Mikhail Ivanov Usov-Tatishchev. Their names are not names of inhabitants of Onfilogovo: they designate officials who measured and recorded the lands of Tver uyezd on behalf of the authorities. The book was authenticated by the diak Semeika Karpov, and from l. 179 onwards by Andrei Myasnov. Since the article on Onfilogovo is on l. 183 ob.–184, Andrei Myasnov's counter-signature is particularly important for this section. These four names help to establish the origin of the record, but not the genealogy of the village.

HOW THE NAME IS FORMED. «Онфилогово» ["Onfilogovo"] consists of the personal stem Onfilog-, the possessive suffix -ov- and the neuter ending -o. The literal meaning is "Onfilog's settlement", "Onfilog's place" or "that which belongs to Onfilog". This is the same pattern as in the neighbouring names Sadykovo, Ishkovo, Ostrogino, Voronino and Popovo: the hamlets are named through their link to a person, but the grammatical form alone does not tell whether he was a peasant, a headman or an owner.

WHAT THE EPONYM WAS CALLED. The most reliably recoverable layer is the personal name Onfilog. The sources contain the closely related vernacular forms Anfilog, Anpilog, Ampilog and Amfilog: scribes rendered the unfamiliar church name by ear, and the initial Amf-, Anf-, Anp- and Onf- fluctuated. N. A. Petrovsky connects the forms Amfil and Amfilokh with the name Amfilokhy (Amphilochius). The onomastician V. A. Nikonov made an important correction: Amfil also existed as a separate canonical name, and in living speech derivatives of Amfilokhy, Amfil, Ampely and Amply could be mixed. Therefore the church form Amfilokhy is the most probable, but it is not proven as rigorously as the everyday name Onfilog.

WHAT THE FULL NAME COULD MEAN. If the original form really was the Greek Amphilochius, Petrovsky explains it through the Greek amphi — "around, on both sides" — and lochos — "ambush"; in the classical tradition Amphilochus is the personal name of a hero. But the meaning of the Greek prototype was not the meaning of the village name for 16th-century Tver inhabitants: for them Onfilogovo meant first of all "Onfilog's village", not "the village of one surrounded by an ambush".

THE NAME WAS REAL, NOT INVENTED FROM THE TOPONYM. The scribal book of Oryol uyezd of 1594/1595 names a former owner «Анпилогом Ивановым сыном Онаньина» ["Anpilog, son of Ivan, Onanyin"], the grandfather of the pomeshchik recorded at that time. The book does not give the exact time of his life and ownership. Ryazan sources know a peasant Anpilog, or Anfilog, son of Ivan, Konstantinov. These people are not the Tver founder and are not in any proven kinship with him, but they show that Anpilog/Anfilog was really used as a male personal name and could belong both to a service landholder and to a peasant.

WHEN THE TVER ONFILOG LIVED. By 1539/1540 the name had already become established, and the hamlet itself had four households. Consequently, the eponym lived before the first surviving survey. A cautious dating is the 15th or the very beginning of the 16th century; a more precise date is impossible until an earlier charter or a record of a transfer of ownership is found. Four households show an already formed hamlet, but do not allow its age to be calculated: it could have grown from a single household or new clearing (pochinok) within one or two generations, or it could have existed longer.

FOUR HOUSEHOLDS — WITHOUT NAMES. Not only the abridged printed text of 1877 has been checked, but also the digital image of the original RGADA book. The article begins on l. 183 ob. and continues on l. 184; there it indeed says «дер. Онфилогово: 4 дв.» ["hamlet of Onfilogovo: 4 households"], immediately followed by the ploughland and hay. There is no household-by-household list and no names of inhabitants. The unknown names of the four householders were not lost by the editor: the scribe himself did not record them. Therefore on this leaf it is impossible to pick one of the four peasants and declare him the founder.

WHO ONFILOG COULD HAVE BEEN. The most vivid scenario is a first settler or the head of a household around which the hamlet grew: a peasant cleared the land, set up a household, and the place came to be called by his name. But grammatically a headman, a minor service landholder or an earlier owner of the land are equally possible. Onfilogovo's position first in the list of six hamlets does not imply seniority and does not prove that it was the centre of the holding. The real Ryazan peasant Anfilog confirms the possibility of the peasant scenario, and the Oryol pomeshchik Anpilog that of the landowner scenario; it is not yet possible to choose between them for Tver.

THE FIRST NAMED HOLDER OF ANFILOGOVO ITSELF. In the official RGADA inventory for d. 16081, after 1634/1635, in the section on vacant lands of Yuryevsky stan, article No. 272 records «поместье Микиты Старкова, пустошь Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["the pomestye of Mikita Starkov, the waste land Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"]. Mikita is the old documentary form of the name Nikita; Starkov is the holder's family naming. He is not the founder: Onfilogovo existed at least 95 years before this entry, and under Mikita it was already counted as a waste land. But he is the first person found to whom, after Stefanida, the place itself belonged.

HOW STEFANIDA'S HOLDING BROKE UP. Neighbouring articles of the same inventory provide a control geography. Article No. 276 names Nikolskoye Svechino, Sadykovo and Ishkovo under Veriga Bulbin; article No. 310 names Voronino and Popovo under Semyon Yurlov. Five matching names within Yuryevsky stan prove that these are parts of a single complex of 1539/1540. By the 17th century it had been divided at least among Starkov, Bulbin and Yurlov, and the former village and hamlets are recorded as waste lands. Semyon's kinship with Ivan and Stefanida has not yet been proven.

THE SECOND NAME LEADS TO THE MODERN MAP. The formula «Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"] means two names of one place. The modern Beloglazovo in Zubtsov district lies only 2.42 km from the scholarly point of Nikolskoye Svechino and about 4 km from Pervitino. Therefore the marker has been moved to 56.316667, 35.242500 with high confidence; it shows the modern centre of Beloglazovo, not the exact sites of the four 16th-century households.

A LATER MAP PRESERVED THE HAMLET. On sheet 1–3 of the General Land Survey plan of Zubtsov uyezd, «д. Воронина» ["hamlet of Voronina"] and «д. Онфилогова» ["hamlet of Onfilogova"] can be read next to each other. This proximity is not accidental: Voronino and Onfilogovo were already in the same list of Stefanida's hamlets in 1539/1540. The label Onfilogova belongs to survey dacha No. 516. This for the first time traces the settlement from the 16th-century scribal book to a plan of the late 18th – early 19th century and gives a new address for research: the economic notes to dacha No. 516 should name its owner at that time, the number of households and the composition of the lands. Until the sheet is georeferenced with sufficient accuracy, the marker should not be presented as the exact site of the households.

WHAT IS PROVEN. In 1539/1540 Onfilogovo existed as a hamlet of four households attached to the village of Nikolskoye Svechino; it was assessed at 30 chetverts of ploughland in each of the three fields and hay meadows for 30 kopnas. The eponym was called by the everyday form Onfilog; his patronymic, social estate, occupation and exact lifetime are still unknown. The original record belongs to Yuryevsky stan of Khorvach volost. A scholarly GIS locates the centre of the Nikolskoye Svechino holding at 56.322586, 35.204732, and the General Land Survey plan (PGM) of Zubtsov uyezd separately shows the hamlet of Onfilogova next to the hamlet of Voronina, in dacha No. 516. The modern link to Beloglazovo is established by the double name and the landholding cluster; within the hamlet the exact sites of the 16th-century households have not been established. Kinship between the Tver Onfilog and the later Anfilogovs has not been established.
strings.Современная привязка Онфилогова к Белогл: The modern link of Onfilogovo to Beloglazovo is established by the double name «Анфилогово, Белоглазово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Beloglazovo"] and the landholding cluster. Only the exact position of the four 16th-century households within the modern territory of the village has not been established.
strings.Не найдены экономические примечания к да: The economic notes to dacha No. 516 have not been found; it is they that should name the owner of Onfilogova in the era of the General Land Survey.
strings.Исповедная ведомость 1741 года содержит: The confession register (ispovednaya vedomost) of 1741 contains several identically named Nikolskoyes. The checked section on internal page 475 belongs to Zakhozhsky stan and is therefore not Nikolskoye Svechino of Volovitsky stan.
strings.В рукописном реестре тверской отказной к: In the manuscript register of the Tver transfer book (otkaznaya kniga) of 7176 (1667/1668), d. 16065, article No. 161, after a new examination of the enlarged official image, a different double name is read: «Анфилогово, Чагримово тож» ["Anfilogovo, also called Chagrimovo"]. It matches the separate hamlet of Onfilogovo, also called Chagrimovo, held by Stepan Afanasyevich Likharev in 1588. Therefore this four-leaf act has been excluded from the ownership chain of our Onfilogovo/Beloglazovo: the earlier readings «Филогово» ["Filogovo"] and «Дылово» ["Dylovo"] were palaeographic errors.
strings.В описи дела РГАДА 16089 найден тверской: In the inventory of RGADA case 16089 a Tver landholder, Rodion Punin syn Yurlov, who disputed a boundary in 1702, has been found. The six-leaf case itself has not yet been examined; his kinship with Ivan Yurlov and his relation to Nikolskoye Svechino have not been established.
strings.В селе Прилук Угличского уезда в 1536/15: In the village of Priluk in Uglich uyezd in 1536/1537 a monastery peasant, Tonkoi Onfilogov, is documented: he is recorded among the non-ploughing households of the votchina of the Trinity-Sergius Monastery. In the naming practice of this era the form «Онфилогов» ["Onfilogov"] primarily points to a father named Onfilog. This real Onfilog lived at a suitable time — probably at the turn of the 15th and 16th centuries. The geographical link is no longer reduced to distance alone: charters of 1461–1466 permitted the peasants and fishermen of the Priluki holding to pass through the Principality of Tver. However, neither the father nor Tonkoi is named in these charters, nor are they shown at Nikolskoye Svechino, so the candidate cannot yet be considered the founder.
strings.Родственная связь с орловскими Анфилогов: A kinship link with Oryol Anfilogovs has not been established and is probably absent.
strings.В данной 1567/1568 года найдено Острогин: In a deed of gift (dannaya) of 1567/1568, Ostrogino of Yuryevsky stan has been found, which the brothers Ivan and Matvei Timofeyevich Tsyzyrev sold to Stepan Oskolkov, who then gave it to the Iosif Monastery. It has not yet been established whether this is the same hamlet that in 1539/1540 was part of Stefanida's holding: the information on the Tsyzyrevs allows for the existence of a second identically named Ostrogino or of separate shares.
